changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ${schema_name_prefix}DATA_RECONCILIATION_ISSUE (ISSUE_KEY, ISSUE_TYPE, DETAILS) SELECT 'REFUND_RETURN:' || c.RETURN_NUMBER, 'REFUND_RETURN_IDENTITY_REVIEW', 'Historical RMA has refund evidence that does not match the canonical refundId=' || c.REFUND_ID || '; automatic continuation is parked' FROM ${schema_name_prefix}PAYMENT_REFUND_RETURN_CONTINUATION c WHERE c.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}RETURN_REQUEST r WHERE r.RETURN_NUMBER = c.RETURN_NUMBER AND r.STATUS = 'APPROVED' ) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}PAYMENT_REFUND exact_refund WHERE exact_refund.REFUND_ID = c.REFUND_ID AND ( exact_refund.ORDER_NUMBER <> c.ORDER_NUMBER OR exact_refund.AMOUNT <> c.REFUND_AMOUNT ) ) OR ( NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}PAYMENT_REFUND exact_refund WHERE exact_refund.REFUND_ID = c.REFUND_ID ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}PAYMENT_REFUND candidate WHERE candidate.ORDER_NUMBER = c.ORDER_NUMBER AND candidate.AMOUNT = c.REFUND_AMOUNT AND candidate.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'COMPLETED') ) ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}DATA_RECONCILIATION_ISSUE issue WHERE issue.ISSUE_KEY = 'REFUND_RETURN:' || c.RETURN_NUMBER )

UPDATE ${schema_name_prefix}PAYMENT_REFUND_RETURN_CONTINUATION c SET STATUS = 'MANUAL_REVIEW', LAST_ERROR = 'Historical refund identity requires operator review before continuation' WHERE c.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}DATA_RECONCILIATION_ISSUE issue WHERE issue.ISSUE_KEY = 'REFUND_RETURN:' || c.RETURN_NUMBER AND issue.ISSUE_TYPE = 'REFUND_RETURN_IDENTITY_REVIEW' )

changeSet.author: cp
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ${schema_name_prefix}DATA_RECONCILIATION_ISSUE (ISSUE_KEY, ISSUE_TYPE, DETAILS) SELECT 'SHIPMENT_OPERATION:' || s.SHIPMENT_NUMBER, 'SHIPMENT_OPERATION_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE', 'Shipment lastOperationId=' || s.LAST_OPERATION_ID || ' predates immutable SHIPMENT_OPERATION history; replay requires current-state conflict handling' FROM ${schema_name_prefix}SHIPMENT s WHERE s.LAST_OPERATION_ID IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}SHIPMENT_OPERATION operation WHERE operation.OPERATION_ID = s.LAST_OPERATION_ID ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${schema_name_prefix}DATA_RECONCILIATION_ISSUE issue WHERE issue.ISSUE_KEY = 'SHIPMENT_OPERATION:' || s.SHIPMENT_NUMBER )
